constraints: Translate only through documented public product/admin operations, using disposable synthetic dossiers and actors. Do not import internals or write private storage.
The adapter reports actions, responses, state and provenance, not a self-awarded case verdict. Validate the translation independently before interpreting candidate results.
Run each declared method/kind at its exact proof boundary. Component arithmetic does not establish a public-interface result; automated reports do not establish human review.
Only use controlled public test facilities for clock, faults, concurrency and restoration. Unsupported or unreproducible operations remain blocked, never passed.
No real client data, paid model calls, live transmission, real financial transactions or regulatory approval is authorized by the suite.
Optional AI phases do not skip mandatory manual preparation, role checks or human validation. Deferred AML/asset-freezing modules cannot be declared compliant.

execution.requiredDimensions: All contract-defined method × kind combinations at the declared boundary must be observed for every required case. No unexecuted dimension can pass.
execution.manualEvidence: External review must name author/reviewer, distinct contexts, target and contract identities, dates, method, findings, verdict and nonempty hashed artifacts. Software identity declarations do not authenticate people.
execution.conformanceClaim: No implementation or contract-wide conformance follows from structural validation. The locked contract remains draft; substantive legal/model review remains separate.
